name: 8bitcn
summary: Free MIT 8-bit styled shadcn/ui components, blocks, and game-ready React interfaces.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~57 documented components (+ many blocks) — not a full inventory.
Distinctive game comps (health/xp/mana bars, enemy health, retro mode switcher) prioritized over plain shadcn restyles.
Registry namespace @8bitcn maps to https://8bitcn.com/r/{name}.json (also www.8bitcn.com).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Clickable 8-bit button with retro borders, variants, and Press Start styling.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @8bitcn/button

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/8bit/button"

<Button>Press Start</Button>

copyPrompt.text: Use 8bitcn free MIT component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://www.8bitcn.com/docs/components/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @8bitcn/button` (official shadcn registry namespace @8bitcn → https://8bitcn.com/r/{name}.json) or `npx shadcn@latest add https://8bitcn.com/r/button.json`. Registry item: https://8bitcn.com/r/button.json. Primary files land under `@/components/ui/8bit/` (retro-mode-switcher under `@/components/ui/retro-mode-switcher`) plus shared `styles/retro.css`. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind / shadcn. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheOrcDev/8bitcn-ui/main/license.md). Pricing free — open source.
